About the bundled folder
========================

The `bundled` folder in this PortableForge copy carries one file
that is NOT PortableForge:

    Sandboxie-Plus-x64-v1.18.8.exe
    (24,930,680 bytes, SHA-256
     f27078ff74a07906fd51476079e1a7a8f5e20c8bb75a9d2ae86169d47179ae76)

It is the official Sandboxie-Plus installer, exactly as its maker
publishes it — unmodified, byte for byte. Copyright 2020–2026
David Xanatos (xanasoft.com) and the Sandboxie contributors.

Why it is here: PortableForge's quick test box is Sandboxie. On a
computer that has no test box yet (for example Windows Home,
which has no built-in one), PortableForge offers to open this
installer so the quick box can be set up. PortableForge checks
the file's fingerprint against the value above before it ever
opens it, and never runs a copy that does not match.

License: Sandboxie-Plus may be redistributed as the original
unmodified binaries, free of charge — that permission, and the
terms for its parts, are in the two license files beside the
installer in this folder:

    Sandboxie-LICENSE-Plus.txt     (Sandboxie-Plus terms)
    Sandboxie-LICENSE-Classic.txt  (the GNU GPL v3, for the core)

PortableForge itself is under the MIT license (see LICENSE) and
claims no rights over Sandboxie. Using Sandboxie is under its
own terms: free for noncommercial use; some extra features of
Sandboxie-Plus itself need a supporter certificate from its
maker, and none of those are needed by PortableForge.

Source code for this exact version of Sandboxie is published by
its maker at https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie
(tag v1.18.8) — the same place this installer came from:
https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/releases/download/v1.18.8/Sandboxie-Plus-x64-v1.18.8.exe
